source_findings: MD14 SFR/yield and fesc implement frozen formulas. Multiplying Msun/year/cMpc3 by photons/s per (Msun/year) needs no additional year factor.
Proper emission = comoving/(Mpc_cm^3*a^3); emission per H = comoving/(Mpc_cm^3*nH0). Total source is solid-angle integrated; each spectral fraction and angular w_mu/2 factor is applied once.

50kK photon blackbody shape E^2/expm1(E/kT), three threshold-adjacent segments, cell E=U/N and normalized N agree with frozen numerical contract. Tests check global moments against 8192 panels and cell means against 64 panels, including 8/16/32 angular parity.
13.6..100 eV injection and reported 100..500 eV omitted tail remain distinct; no hidden tail injection. Source law only accepts zbar in [4,20].

radiation_helper_findings.initial_angle_variable: mu0 is initial physical direction; integration is over 0..1 exploiting reflection symmetry, without evolved-angle weighting a second time.
radiation_helper_findings.formula: db=b-b_ref; R=sqrt((1-mu0^2)*exp(2db)+mu0^2*exp(-4db)); mu_local=mu0*exp(-2db)/R; epsilon_iso=epsilon_ref*(a_ref/a)^4; epsilon=epsilon_iso*integral_0^1 R dmu0; DeltaP=P_parallel-P_perp=epsilon_iso*integral_0^1 R*P2(mu_local) dmu0.
radiation_helper_findings.sign_and_normalization: Small db: DeltaP/epsilon_iso=-8db/5+O(db^2). b=0 returns isotropic redshifting energy and zero quadrupole within arithmetic tolerance; exact dipole zero is justified by enforced reflection pairing.
radiation_helper_findings.units: epsilon_ref, epsilon, DeltaP and signed energy correction use J/m3. Combined with k=8piG/(3c^2), delta_s=a^-3 integral a^3*k*DeltaP dt has units s^-1; ionizing nH[cm^-3]*U2[eV/H] converts using 1.602176634e-13 J/m3 per eV/cm3.
radiation_helper_findings.energy_correction: Helper retains signed epsilon-epsilon_iso. Caller explicitly chooses a conservative absolute/envelope treatment when feeding nonnegative extra_energy; never substitutes a negative correction into the nonnegative diagnostic input.

remaining_driver_obligations: Convert locally isotropic emissivity to evolved fixed covariant ray directions using the correct solid-angle Jacobian, normalizing finite weights once. cell_per_h_s uses local quadrature and is not by itself that geometric map.
Use entire effective Omega_r initially isotropic radiation envelope with epsilon_ref=rho_crit0*c^2*Omega_r/a_ref^4 plus actual ionizing radiation quadrupole; CMB subset alone is insufficient.
